post.description:
Creates a new app.

:param app: :class:`App`
:param no_compute: bool (optional)
  If true, the app will not be started after creation.

:returns:
  Long-running operation waiter for :class:`App`.
  See :method:wait_get_app_active for more details.

resolved_commit.description: The resolved commit SHA that was actually used for the deployment. This is populated by the system after resolving the reference (branch, tag, or commit). If commit is specified directly, this will match commit. If a branch or tag is specified, this contains the commit SHA that the branch or tag pointed to at deployment time.

source_code_path.description: Relative path to the app source code within the Git repository. If not specified, the root of the repository is used.

GitSource.description: Complete git source specification including repository location and reference.

next_page_token.description: Pagination token to request the next page of apps.
Pagination token to request the next page of apps.

done.description: If the value is ``false``, it means the operation is still in progress. If ``true``, the operation is completed, and either ``error`` or ``response`` is available.

error.description: The error result of the operation in case of failure or cancellation.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata associated with the operation. It typically contains progress information and common metadata such as create time. Some services might not provide such metadata.

name.description: The server-assigned name, which is only unique within the same service that originally returns it. If you use the default HTTP mapping, the ``name`` should be a resource name ending with ``operations/{unique_id}``.

response.description: The normal, successful response of the operation.

Operation.description: This resource represents a long-running operation that is the result of a network API call.

create_time.description: The creation time of the app space. Formatted timestamp in ISO 6801.

creator.description: The email of the user that created the app space.

description.description: The description of the app space.

effective_usage_policy_id.description: The effective usage policy ID used by apps in the space.

effective_user_api_scopes.description: The effective api scopes granted to the user access token.

group_id.description: The ID of the group attached to the app space. ASPs minted for apps in this space are added as members of this group at create time, so the group's resource permissions flow through to every app in the space.

id.description: The unique identifier of the app space.

resources.description: Resources for the app space. Resources configured at the space level are available to all apps in the space.

service_principal_client_id.description: The service principal client ID for the app space.

service_principal_id.description: The service principal ID for the app space.

service_principal_name.description: The service principal name for the app space.

status.description: The status of the app space.

telemetry_export_destinations.description: Telemetry export destinations for all apps in this space. When configured, all apps in the space export OTEL telemetry (logs, metrics, traces) to the specified Unity Catalog tables.

update_time.description: The update time of the app space. Formatted timestamp in ISO 6801.

updater.description: The email of the user that last updated the app space.

usage_policy_id.description: The usage policy ID for managing cost at the space level.

user_api_scopes.description: OAuth scopes for apps in the space.

state.description: The state of the app space.

SpaceUpdateStatus.description: Status of an app space update operation

TelemetryExportDestination.description: A single telemetry export destination with its configuration and status.

logs_table.description: Unity Catalog table for OTEL logs.

metrics_table.description: Unity Catalog table for OTEL metrics.

traces_table.description: Unity Catalog table for OTEL traces (spans).

UnityCatalog.description: Unity Catalog Destinations for OTEL telemetry export.
